issue.title: Stop downloading full master data on every Sync Now and ignore repeated taps [Offline chapter assignment Audit]
issue.body:
## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Sync Now does not download full languages (~7.6k) / books / bibles catalogues when unchanged
- [ ] Sync uses `updatedAfter` (or equivalent) for master data when the Fluent API supports it
- [ ] If the API lacks support, the developer opens the fluent-api issue at implementation time and links it here — **done: [fluent-api#373](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/373)**
- [ ] Pending claims and user data do not wait for master data (reorder or parallelize)
- [ ] Concurrent Sync Now / login sync cannot start a second overlapping full sync (single-flight)
- [ ] Unit tests cover incremental skip / cursor behavior and single-flight
- [ ] Needs QA on device: timed Sync Now before/after on Wi‑Fi with a warm cache

## Context

From [#533](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/533) audit (P1):

> Sync Now re-downloads ~7.6k languages + books + bibles every time (~30s on Wi‑Fi) before claims/assignments. Master data should be incremental (`updatedAfter`) or cached; claims should not wait behind that catalogue pull.

Also overlaps with login/post-login sync contention (429 risk when Sync Now overlaps login sync).

## Suggested approach

1. Confirm whether Fluent API list endpoints for languages/books/bibles accept `updatedAfter` (or similar).
2. If yes: wire client + persist last-successful master sync cursor; skip empty responses.
3. If no: open fluent-api ticket and temporarily reorder sync so user/claim steps run before or in parallel with master data.
4. Add a process-wide single-flight guard around `syncAllUsers` / full sync orchestration (same pattern as other in-flight sync locks in the app).

## Related

- Parent audit: #533
- API follow-up: [eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api#373](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/373)
